user.title: Connect your DIGI account
user.description: Enter the credentials you use on digi.ro or in the MyDigi app. After this step, DIGI sends a code by SMS to the account's phone.

data_description.username: The email address of your DIGI account or your client ID.
data_description.password: Stored locally in Home Assistant; used only to reconnect the account when the DIGI session expires.

two_factor.title: Code received by SMS
two_factor.description:
DIGI sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. The code expires in 2 minutes.

If you did not receive it, tick "Send the code again" and press Submit (a new code can be requested after one minute).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your DIGI account
reauth_confirm.description:
The DIGI session of {username} has expired and updates have stopped. Press Submit: DIGI will send you a new code by SMS.

Fill in the password only if you changed it in the meantime.

reconfigure.title: Change the DIGI account credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the new credentials. A code by SMS follows.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the email (or client ID) and password — they are the same as on digi.ro.
error.captcha: DIGI now asks for an anti-robot check (captcha) at login, which the integration cannot pass. Please open an issue on GitHub.
error.cannot_connect: digi.ro could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again in a few minutes.
error.login_failed: DIGI answered unexpectedly at login. Enable debug logging, try again and look for the details in the log.
error.code_wait: DIGI will not send a new code yet. Wait one minute, then tick "Send the code again".
error.code_send_failed: The SMS code could not be sent. Tick "Send the code again" or try later.
error.code_required: Enter the code received by SMS or tick "Send the code again".
error.code_not_sent: The code has not been sent yet. Tick "Send the code again".
error.code_invalid: The code was rejected. Check the 6 digits (the code expires in 2 minutes) or request a new one.
error.code_failed: The code verification failed. Request a new code and try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Enable debug logging for this integration, try again, then look for the details in the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This DIGI account is already added to Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_successful: The account was reconnected and updates have resumed.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The credentials were updated and the integration was reloaded.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in to a different DIGI account than the one configured here. For another account, add the integration again as a separate entry.
abort.cannot_connect: The account data could not be read after signing in. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Enable debug logging and try again.

licenta.title: DIGI România license
licenta.description:
{license_status}

Enter the license key you received by email.

data_description.license_key: The key from your license email, in the form DIGI-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

error.license_key_invalid: This key is not valid for DIGI România. Copy the whole key from the email: keys for this integration start with DIGI-.
error.license_already_used: This key is active on another Home Assistant instance. The license email address receives a link to move it; after you confirm, enter the key here again.
error.license_fingerprint_mismatch: Activation could not be confirmed for this instance. Try again; if the message repeats, use the “License problem” form.
error.license_network_error: The license server cannot be reached. Check that Home Assistant has internet access and try again.
error.license_server_error: The license server could not check the key right now. Try again in a few minutes.

trial_expired.title: The DIGI România free trial has ended
trial_expired.description:
Sensors stop updating until a license is activated.

[Get a license]({learn_more_url})

license_expired.title: The DIGI România license has expired
license_expired.description:
Sensors stop updating until the license is renewed.

[Get a new license]({learn_more_url})
